test_name: Verify Navigation Through Test Suites and Detailed View
description: Ensure users can navigate through the list of test suites, search for a specific suite, and view detailed information about the selected suite.
steps: Locate and click on the 'Test Suites' link using its stable selector.
Verify the page loads successfully with the list of test suites.
Identify the search bar using its stable selector.
Type the name of the test suite to be searched into the search bar.
Wait for the search results to update dynamically.
Locate the specific test suite row in the table.
Click on the test suite row using its stable selector.
Verify the detailed view of the test suite is displayed.
Check that the details include creation and modification history.
expected_results: The user can see the list of test suites.
Search functionality filters the list based on the input.
The selected test suite's detailed view is displayed correctly.
Details include creation and modification history.
edge_cases: Search term does not match any test suites.
Network latency causes delayed search results.
Test suite row is clicked but does not load details.
User navigates away from the page before the detailed view loads.
data_requirements: Test suite details such as creation and modification history.
dependencies: Test suites are already created and listed on the page.
Detailed view feature is fully operational.
api_interactions: API call to fetch test suite details.
API call to filter test suites during search.
API call to retrieve detailed view data.
performance_metrics: Time taken for search results to update.
Page load time for detailed view.
Response time of API calls for test suite details.
accessibility_requirements: Search bar must be navigable via keyboard.
Test suite rows must have ARIA labels for screen readers.
Detailed view must conform to WCAG 2.1 AA standards.
